g.text: Previous / next day in the selector (wraps to All)
Move focus between panels; scroll a table
Select today (and jump to the current month)
Device filter: all, cpu, gpu, rest, measured
Open the selected day (on All: the week view)
Week view: 7 day bars and a table; ←/→ move by week
Live view: watts per device, 10-minute sparkline
Event log (boots, gaps, warnings) for the shown period
Close the panel / go back; on the main screen: exit
